$comment: HAND-EDITED source of Appearance > Glass: the material, tint, tint strength and veil of each glass surface role (schemas/surface-roles/surface-roles.json), the agent pane composer and chrome (cmuxterm-hq docs/design/customization-api-state.md section 4). Every default is today's look: an unset key changes nothing. cmux-config's glass module (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-config/src/glass/mod.rs) embeds this file and resolves and clamps the values; scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: glass
lists.note: Off the page: set from theme files, the palette, cmux settings and MCP.

rows.name: popoverMaterial
rows.note: The material the popover role (popovers, hover cards, the palette, find and prompt bars) draws. Unset keeps the built-in pick (OverlayGlassVariant.picked; the chrome's own material). Reduce Transparency wins over it.

choices.note: the glass the role draws today: Liquid Glass on macOS 26 (the blur before it) natively, the blur on web pages (GlassLensMode.plain)
Liquid Glass's clear variant: more of the backdrop shows through
the frosted blur (NSVisualEffectView) with the role's veil and rim, on every macOS
no blur: the tint alone over the backdrop
opt-in, web surfaces: refracts the backdrop at the rim (GlassLensMode.lens, the glass engine); a native surface draws plain glass for it. Never a default
opt-in, web surfaces: the lens with a chromatic split at the rim (GlassLensMode.spectrum); a native surface draws plain glass for it

rows.page_hidden: glass roles are set from theme files, the palette, cmux settings and MCP (docs/cmux-next/theme-recipes.md); 36 rows do not fit a card

rows.name: popoverTint
rows.note: The popover role's glass tint. Unset is the theme's glass tint (Palette.glassTint), as before.
rows.page_hidden: glass roles are set from theme files, the palette, cmux settings and MCP (docs/cmux-next/theme-recipes.md); 36 rows do not fit a card

rows.name: popoverTintStrength
rows.note: How much denser than the tint's own alpha the popover role's tint is (GlassLevel.tintStrength: chrome 1, popover and menu 1.25, chip 1.5). The default is today's level, so an unset key changes nothing.
rows.page_hidden: glass roles are set from theme files, the palette, cmux settings and MCP (docs/cmux-next/theme-recipes.md); 36 rows do not fit a card

rows.name: popoverVeil
rows.note: The alpha of the veil the popover role lays over its glass for legible text, in light and dark alike. Unset keeps the role's own light and dark veils (FloatingGlassStyle).
